test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Five persons are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Aman is an immediate neighbour of both Ansu and Ajit. Akash sits second to the left of Aman. Ansh sits second to the right of Aman. Akash is an immediate neighbour of both Ansu and Ansh. Who is an immediate neighbour of both Ajit and Akash?
solution:
Given: Five persons are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Akash sits second to the left of Aman.

2) Ansh sits second to the right of Aman.
